  "text": "The outdoor classroom began today. Day 265. Zone 1. The radish row. 6 students: the Naive Son, the Feral Orphan, the Child Soldier, the bunker-born children (2). The sixth student is the Bouncer. The Bouncer asked to sit in. He said he is the watcher and the watching is the learning. I said the watching is the learning. He sat at the edge. I taught the water cycle on the surface. The water cycle on the surface is not the water cycle in the book. The water cycle on the surface is the stream at the east edge of zone 2 (the spring melt, running). The water cycle on the surface is the rain that will come. The water cycle on the surface is the water in the soil that the radish is drinking. The radish is drinking the water cycle. The water cycle is not a thing in the book. The water cycle is a thing in the soil. The soil is the classroom. The surface is the classroom. The classroom is the thing that does not have walls. The classroom in the bunker has walls. The classroom on the surface has the sky. The sky is the wall that is not a wall. The sky is the thing the Chemist does not look at. The Chemist does not come to the outdoor classroom. The Chemist stays in the lab. The lab is the Chemist's classroom. The surface is the children's classroom. The classrooms are different. The learning is the same. The water cycle happens in the book and in the soil and in the sky. The water cycle does not know where it happens. The water cycle happens. The Naive Son said, 'The water cycle is the thing that does not need us.' I said, 'The water cycle is the thing that does not need us. The water cycle is the thing we need.' He said, 'That is the thing my mother would have said.' He said 'would have.' The tense is still the past. The past is the thing the Naive Son carries. The past is the thing the water cycle does not carry. The water cycle is the present. The Naive Son is the past. The Bouncer is the watching. The Child Soldier is the writing. The Feral Orphan is the listening. The bunker-born children are the playing. The outdoor classroom is the thing that has all of us. The outdoor classroom is the thing that does not have walls. The walls are in the bunker. The surface does not have walls. The surface has the sky. The sky is the wall that is not a wall. The sky is the thing the learning is under.",
